title: Implement mbox file parser and backfill importer
description:
Implement an mbox (RFC 4155) parser that reads a file or directory of .mbox files, extracts individual messages, maps them to Usenet articles (From_, headers), and feeds each into the transit store-and-forward pipeline. Groups extracted from Newsgroups: header; articles without Newsgroups: are assigned to a configurable default group or skipped. Artifact: transit/src/import/mbox.rs.

Acceptance:
- Parses standard Unix mbox format (From_ separator line)
- Handles multi-gigabyte mbox files without loading entire file into memory
- Articles without Newsgroups: header: configurable skip or assign-to-default
- Progress: prints article count every 1000 articles
- Test: import a 500-message mbox file, verify all CIDs indexed
